title: Gluttony Origin
body:
Gluttony, Devourer of all

🟢 Glutton: Whenever you kill a player you get slightly stronger stacking indefinitely,
- There is a 1/5 chance that you could get a random powerful bounus power
- 30 min CD

🔴 Endless Hunger: 3x hunger drain

🔴 Heavy: Sinks In water

🔴 Sin: Wolfs and iron golems attack you on sight, and villagers wont trade with you
  
Requires Pekhui [https://modrinth.com/mod/pehkui](https://modrinth.com/mod/pehkui)
  
Pekhui config needs to be changed so, "keepAllScalesOnRespawn": true

If you would like to commision an origin, find me on the origins discord
[https://discord.gg/fxHqS36tun](https://discord.gg/fxHqS36tun)
